line.en: the bugis street night market is open until 10pm; go after dinner and walk the stalls. it is an open-air market, so look at the sky before you set off.
line.de: der nachtmarkt in der bugis street hat bis 22 uhr offen; nach dem abendessen hingehen und die stände ablaufen. es ist ein markt unter freiem himmel, also vorher den himmel prüfen.
line.tr: bugis street gece pazarı 22:00'ye kadar açık; akşam yemeğinden sonra gidip tezgâhları gez. açık hava pazarı, yola çıkmadan önce havaya bak.

sparks.why: Bugis Street Market is a permanent night market open until 10pm daily, per Secret Singapore's 2026 best-night-markets piece; the 7 nov forecast was not confirmed.
